title: Stuck alarm
body: I deleted the app but it left an alarm on my phone I can’t find nor delete.
author: Anoniem-Meinona

title: Locket out of app
body: I really like the app. It helped me a lot for a while. Then I stopped using it for a while and when I came back to it my Lifetime Pro Access had disappeared. I don’t see any option to redeem my purchase. My only option now is to buy  a new subscription.
author: Dacvrijma

title: Access denied
body: Like the app. Unfortunately there seems to be a bug and now I can’t access the app.
author: TinaBelcher99

title: Great app!!
body: So helpful to build a routine or new habits, the timers make it so much easier for me to get things done.
author: Francineleh

title: I lost my Lifetime Pro Access
body: Hey, I really appreciate RoutineFlow! When I got my new iPhone I have lost my username and password accidentally. I just have my order number. Is it possible to reclaim my Lifetime Pro Access? Thank you very much in advance!
author: Ennalion

title: Google and Meta (Facebook) tracking
body: If I read the privacy terms and I see Google and Meta (Facebook) in one sentence, then I am gone. Nothing is anonymous for those companies. They always can track you back to a real person.  Too bad, because this app could be a real help. Developer, there are also privacy friendly solutions to build and analyze a app.
author: AppleUserEU
